children: We celebrated the launch of YT Industries new trail bike IZZO by creating a film that honours the classic anime fight sequence, incorporating supernatural elements from Japanese folklore in an adrenaline fuelled slash-and-climb to the top of a sacred temple.

When the legends at YT Industries asked us to produce an authentic anime cinematic for their cutting-edge new bike, IZZO, we were not slow to respond. You want a big old anime sword fight? Say no more! IZZO follows a masked hero as he fights several demons with his ultra sharp sword on his way to the peak of a Japanese city. He’s Fast, Agile and Sharp; qualities that echo the key attributes of IZZO, the brand new trail bike released by YT Industries. Directed by Wesley Louis and Alvise Zennaro. Together they handpicked a small but elite pack of artists to make characters swoop, cut and splatter across your screens like a Japanese ink brush. Our intent was to honour the classic anime fight sequence but bring something new and unexpected to the table. The collaborative spirit of everyone at SHIFT Active Media and YT allowed us to create something really unique. With the combined effort of our in-house team, as well as friends from outside The Line, we managed to craft something that we’re immensely proud of. Enjoy!
